information: For Safety Precautions, we ask that competitors and their **one guest** only be in the venue during the competition's scheduled time. There are many benches and areas around the Campus to explore for other guests who there may not be space for within the venue. -Please review the **COVID precautions tab** for information regarding the steps taken to increase competitor safety at this competition. -Please review the **competitor information** tab before the competition. -Please review **all other** tabs for more information on the competition.
